blocking.fix: Clear the names' inline widths and war-tight whenever the row is not a phone's; count fit again when `phone` changes (or reset rowWidth when the ResizeObserver is attached). Seen fixed when c83_phoneToDesk 68901 400 shows 2 banners at the second 384x832 and no inline width at 1280/1024/1600; 83903 700 375x667,1280x720,1024x768,375x667 shows 2 banners at the last step; 83901 400 384x832,1366x768,1024x768,384x832 shows 'Nationalist Spain' whole at 1366; c83_rotate 68901 400 GER 20 and 83903 700 GER 30 stay at 0 stale.
